# Data Source: identitynow_scheduled_search

Use this data source to look up a scheduled search by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_scheduled_search" "daily" {
  id = "4dc7ca01-0ca6-4c12-9e4b-4b5fed1a1a3b"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Scheduled search ID.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Scheduled search description.
- `display_query_details` (Boolean) Whether the email includes the query and a preview of the results.
- `email_empty_results` (Boolean) Whether an email is sent when the search returns no results.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scheduled search is enabled.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Scheduled search name.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Owner of the scheduled search, with `type` and `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `recipient` (Attributes List) Identities that receive the search results, with `type` and `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recipient))
- `saved_search_id` (String) ID of the saved search that is run.
- `schedule_json` (String) Schedule as a JSON object.

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identity ID.
- `type` (String) Identity type.


<a id="nestedatt--recipient"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recipient`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identity ID.
- `type` (String) Identity type.
